research_question: At culture ordering for adult inpatients, retain the 90-day resistance-history alert and quantify the additional positive-patient coverage and additional review burden of model-based supplementary alerts.

adult_eligibility.timepoint: first culture request T0 of fixed 24h event
adult_eligibility.wards: All adult inpatient wards in scope, ICU and non-ICU; ward names are not used as a substitute for age
adult_eligibility.missing_age: Classed as age not determinable; eligibility is not obtained by model imputation
adult_eligibility.birthday_history: Reports from the 90 days before the 18th birthday that meet the time-availability rule may still be used for history variables of adult events

cohort_periods.external: Existing adapted MIMIC cohort; all adults under the existing mapping

membership: Keep the current frozen candidate entry, 24-h event grouping, T0, cross-period patient exclusion and five-fold mapping, and restrict each existing cohort to adults; removing paediatric records does not reassign patients or restore excluded returning patients. Any later change requires a new version and new counts.
outcome: As in v7: formal Status 3/4 reports; IsNotReport, Reported and CancelFlag are not used as thresholds; CRE/CRPA/CRAB target organisms with linkable susceptibility results or a confirmed formal resistance conclusion; negative and unknown outcomes are separated under the current rules.
external_mapping: The first version keeps the current MIMIC adaptation rules and unknown categories; any refinement such as flora or low-count rules is frozen and evaluated separately and is not automatically treated as negative.
history: Keep the verified v7 history-evidence threshold: formal reports available in [T0-90d, T0), excluding requests within the current 24-h event; no qualifying record does not mean a known absence of history; the adult restriction does not truncate eligible history sources.

primary_model.select: development mean held-fold log loss; ties smaller C
primary_model.preprocess: Existing category domains and missing codes; numerical imputation and standardisation fitted separately in each training fold
primary_model.weighting: Each culture event weighted equally; no SMOTE or class resampling

development_evaluation: Patient-level nested CV with 5 outer and 4 inner folds, as in the most recent comparison workflow; the final C for the full adult development data is selected by 5-fold CV. All adult within-fold models are refitted; all-age models are not reused. The non-nested OOF scores of the original v7 are not used as nested results for this version.
supplementary_algorithms: Reuse the fixed RF/XGBoost grids recorded on 2026-10-14 as a supplementary comparison; the main model is not changed and tuning does not continue on the basis of 2025/2026/MIMIC results.
freeze_sequence: Verify the age source and its consistency with T0
Freeze the adult protocol, entry, outcome, features and fold mapping, with hashes
Fit and tune on adult development events with known outcomes only
Save the final model, preprocessing, coefficients and fitting log, with hashes
Then score and evaluate 2025, 2026 and MIMIC

strategy.H90: Keep all history alerts available at the time
strategy.addon_pool: Adult candidate events without an H90 alert, including unknown outcomes
comparators: ICU priority; expected result with the budget allocated uniformly within strata
ICU priority, then descending length of stay before ordering, as a supplementary benchmark

endpoints: Additional positive patients covered over the whole evaluation period, deduplicated across selected positive events
Known-positive, known non-positive and unknown events among additional alerts counted separately
Additional alerts per additional positive patient covered; no finite ratio is reported when the denominator is 0
Whether the first known positive event is alerted; a separate sensitivity analysis covers earlier unknown outcomes

uncertainty.unit: paired patient cluster; keep all events of sampled patient copies
uncertainty.limitation: Fixed-score intervals do not include all training and design-choice uncertainty; multiple budgets are not independent validations

sensitivity_reruns: First known positive event and earlier unknown events
H90 observation span and exclusion of the first 90 development days, with refit
Outcome of the first request in the 24-h event and the at-T0 definition
claims: Limited to adult inpatient culture events; no generalisation to paediatrics
The 2025/2026 source data had already been accessed by programs; rebuilding the adult cohort does not make them new, unseen validation data
The investigator stated that earlier 2026 results were not consulted; program access is not described as analysis by the author
Retrospective coverage is not described as earlier diagnosis or treatment benefit
No clinically acceptable cost was prespecified; no claim of proven acceptability is made
optional_user_input: If a different workflow is wanted, state whether to change periods, ward scope or patient splits; a clinically acceptable alert burden may be added when real evidence is available.
new_microbiology_information: Supplement to the methods description; the frozen outcome is not changed. External expert mapping is handled as a separate sensitivity-analysis version. Questions remain about historical interpretation versions and switch-over times.
